{mx:site_hero_headline}Roof leaks fixed fast, without the surprise bill{/mx}

{mx:site_hero_subheadline}Leaks, storm damage and full restorations for Brisbane homes. Free, no-obligation quotes within 24 hours.{/mx}

{mx:site_usp_1}Free quote within 24 hours{/mx}

{mx:site_usp_2}Licensed, insured and local{/mx}

{mx:site_usp_3}10-year workmanship guarantee{/mx}

{mx:site_guarantee}If you are not happy with the job, we come back and make it right at no cost. Every job is backed by our 10-year workmanship guarantee.{/mx}

{mx:site_offer}Free roof health check with every quote{/mx}

{mx:site_owner_bio}I started Summit Roofing because I was tired of seeing homeowners get burned by cowboys. We are a small local team, we answer the phone, we turn up when we say we will, and we treat your home like our own.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_1_name}Roof Repairs{/mx}

{mx:site_service_1_slug}roof-repairs{/mx}

{mx:site_service_1_desc}Leaks, cracked tiles and broken flashing found and fixed fast, with photos before and after.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_1_body}Most leaks start small: a cracked tile, a lifted flashing or a blocked valley. We find the cause, show you photos and fix it properly so it doesn't come back next storm. Every repair gets a fixed written price before we start.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_2_name}Roof Restoration{/mx}

{mx:site_service_2_slug}roof-restoration{/mx}

{mx:site_service_2_desc}Clean, repair, re-point and re-coat to add 15+ years to your roof for a fraction of a replacement.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_2_body}A restoration brings an old tile or metal roof back to near new. We pressure clean, replace broken tiles, re-bed and re-point the ridge caps, then apply a sealer and two coats of membrane paint in the colour you choose.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_3_name}Re-Roofing{/mx}

{mx:site_service_3_slug}re-roofing{/mx}

{mx:site_service_3_desc}Full tile-to-metal and metal-to-metal replacements with a clean site every day.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_3_body}When a roof is past repair, we strip it back and replace it with new Colorbond or tiles. We check the battens and gutters while it is open, keep the site tidy each day and handle the council paperwork.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_4_name}Storm Damage{/mx}

{mx:site_service_4_slug}storm-damage{/mx}

{mx:site_service_4_desc}Emergency make-safe and insurance-ready reports after hail, wind and storm events.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_4_body}After hail or wind damage we make the roof safe quickly, then document the damage with photos and a written report your insurer can use. We can work directly with your insurer's assessor.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_5_name}Gutters and Downpipes{/mx}

{mx:site_service_5_slug}gutters-downpipes{/mx}

{mx:site_service_5_desc}New gutters, downpipes and guards that stop overflow and protect your foundations.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_5_body}Overflowing gutters cause rot, leaks and foundation damage. We replace gutters and downpipes in Colorbond, fit leaf guards and make sure water runs away from the house.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_6_name}Roof Inspections{/mx}

{mx:site_service_6_slug}roof-inspections{/mx}

{mx:site_service_6_desc}Detailed photo reports for buyers, sellers and insurers, usually within 48 hours.{/mx}

{mx:site_service_6_body}Buying, selling or just worried? We inspect the whole roof, including flashings, valleys and the roof space, and send a photo report within 48 hours with clear priorities and prices.{/mx}

{mx:site_area_1_name}Logan{/mx}

{mx:site_area_1_slug}roofing-logan{/mx}

{mx:site_area_1_suburbs}Springwood, Shailer Park, Daisy Hill, Beenleigh and Loganholme{/mx}

{mx:site_area_1_body}A lot of Logan homes went up in the 80s and 90s, and their concrete tiles and ridge capping are now due for attention. We're in Logan most weeks for repairs, restorations and storm call-outs, so we can usually inspect within a couple of days.{/mx}

{mx:site_area_2_name}Ipswich{/mx}

{mx:site_area_2_slug}roofing-ipswich{/mx}

{mx:site_area_2_suburbs}Booval, Brassall, Raceview, Redbank Plains and Ripley{/mx}

{mx:site_area_2_body}Ipswich has plenty of old Queenslanders with their original corrugated iron, alongside the new estates out at Ripley. We repair and re-roof both, and we match heritage profiles where the street calls for it.{/mx}

{mx:site_area_3_name}Redcliffe{/mx}

{mx:site_area_3_slug}roofing-redcliffe{/mx}

{mx:site_area_3_suburbs}Scarborough, Margate, Woody Point, Clontarf and Kippa-Ring{/mx}

{mx:site_area_3_body}Salt air off the bay eats through cheap fixings and flashings faster than most people expect. On the peninsula we use marine-grade fasteners and Colorbond Ultra where it's needed, so the roof holds up.{/mx}

{mx:site_area_4_name}Springfield{/mx}

{mx:site_area_4_slug}roofing-springfield{/mx}

{mx:site_area_4_suburbs}Springfield Lakes, Augustine Heights, Brookwater, Spring Mountain and Camira{/mx}

{mx:site_area_4_body}Most Springfield homes are fairly new, so the work here is usually storm damage, overflowing gutters and builder defects that show up once the warranty runs out. If it's a quick fix, we'll tell you.{/mx}

{mx:site_area_5_name}North Lakes{/mx}

{mx:site_area_5_slug}roofing-north-lakes{/mx}

{mx:site_area_5_suburbs}Mango Hill, Griffin, Kallangur, Petrie and Narangba{/mx}

{mx:site_area_5_body}North Lakes cops some heavy summer storms rolling in off the hinterland. We do a lot of hail and wind damage repairs here, and we can supply the photos and report your insurer will ask for.{/mx}

{mx:site_area_6_name}Redland City{/mx}

{mx:site_area_6_slug}roofing-redland-city{/mx}

{mx:site_area_6_suburbs}Cleveland, Capalaba, Victoria Point, Thornlands and Alexandra Hills{/mx}

{mx:site_area_6_body}Between the bay breeze and the big gums, Redlands roofs deal with salt and a steady fall of leaves. Gutter guards and a regular valley clean prevent a lot of leaks here, and we can quote both on the same visit.{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_1_q}How much does a roof repair cost?{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_1_a}Most repairs fall between $350 and $1,500 depending on access and materials. We give you a fixed written price before any work starts, so there are no surprises.{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_2_q}How quickly can you come out?{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_2_a}We usually inspect within 1 to 2 business days, and same day for active leaks and storm damage.{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_3_q}Are you licensed and insured?{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_3_a}Yes. We hold a current QBCC licence and full public liability insurance, and we are happy to send certificates before we start.{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_4_q}Do you offer a guarantee?{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_4_a}Every job comes with our 10-year workmanship guarantee on top of the manufacturer warranty on materials.{/mx}
